description: PS5 store and download manager with a browser UI on port 34177. Library integration requires ShadowMountPlus.

changelog: > **🎉 Orbit is now on PS4 too.** Get the new [Orbit Store for PS4](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps4) port, with downloads and setup instructions in its own repository.
We’re shipping new features and fixes across Orbit Store and Orbit Zero.

**Scores and playtimes for 1,663 games.** See Metacritic scores and HowLongToBeat estimates on game pages. Browse by minimum score or playtime, choose Main Story, Main + Extras or Completionist, and save your filters. Coverage includes 645 scores and 1,568 playtime records; games with unknown values remain unlabelled. You can hide scores and playtimes on game cards in **Appearance**.
**Remember your download choice.** Orbit remembers Direct or TorBox. Turn on **Always use TorBox** to use it for new downloads, subject to your account and the source’s support.
**Improved Vikingfile downloads.** Better download-link detection and support for more Vikingfile servers help Orbit capture links more reliably across Orbit Store and Orbit Zero.
**A clearer Library.** Games and Files stay together, with one counted **All games / Available now / Missing source** filter. Separate **Installed** and **Mounted** badges show each game’s status.
**More catalogue detail.** Orbit now has **2,390 games with 5,335 download options**, plus **631 add-ons with 633 options across 197 base games**.

**Artwork stays ready between visits.** Orbit keeps a bounded artwork cache across restarts, reuses cached backup images when a host is unavailable, and uses smaller images for tiles across the native app, browser and Zero.

**Check game folders before making repairs.** Orbit automatically checks extracted game folders. For an existing folder, open **Library → Files → Verify & Repair**. Review proposed changes before applying them. Orbit can restore required permissions and fix uniquely matched filename-capitalization errors; missing files remain warnings.

**Find games inside nested folders.** After extraction or a transfer from Zero, Orbit sends the actual game folder to supported ShadowMount versions, even when it sits inside another folder. Existing completed downloads can use **Scan with ShadowMount** to try again without redownloading.
We’re shipping improvements and bug fixes across our apps:
Fixed the Downloads list jumping or losing your selection when you resume a download, refresh the list or remove an entry. This applies to all four layouts.
Fixed downloads looking stuck on **Inspecting archive**.
Fixed an issue where paused or failed downloads stopped you from adding new downloads.
Fixed the Downloads list moving around as downloads change status or when you close a download’s details. This applies to all four layouts.
Fixed file permissions when sending game folders to the PS5, including when resuming an interrupted transfer.
Settings now shows the right catalogue revision and tells you if a refresh fails.

> **Orbit stays free.** [Orbit Store](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps5), [Orbit Zero](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps5#orbit-zero-for-mac-windows-and-linux), [Orbit Play](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-play-ps5) and our upcoming apps are free and will stay free.

> I’ve been building Orbit in my own time and covering the costs of AI tools, test consoles, hardware and servers. If you’d like to help, you can [support Orbit via crypto](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps5/issues/131#user-content-support-with-crypto). It’s entirely optional.
**TorBox filtering and fixes across Orbit.**

**Find downloads supported by TorBox.** With TorBox connected, choose **Browse → Source → TorBox available** to find games with a supported download option. You can save this choice with your other filters.
**Clearer extraction errors.** Orbit explains when an archive is damaged, incomplete or uses unsupported compression.
**News from Orbit.** Short notices about catalogue additions and other Orbit news can appear in the native PS5 app, browser (ELF) and Orbit Zero.
The catalogue now has **2,200 games and 5,100 download options**, plus **628 add-ons with 630 options across 194 base games**.

> **Orbit stays free.** [Orbit Store](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps5), [Orbit Zero](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps5#orbit-zero-for-mac-windows-and-linux), [Orbit Play](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-play-ps5) and our upcoming apps are free and will stay free.

> I’ve been building Orbit in my own time and covering the costs of AI tools, test consoles, hardware and servers. If you’d like to help, you can support Orbit on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/saawant12) or [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/saawant12). It’s entirely optional.
We’re also shipping improvements and bug fixes across our apps:
**Chinese, Japanese and Korean show correctly in the native app.** With one of these languages selected, most text showed as question marks.
